purpose: Compile the approved story into deterministic platform render manifests and treatment rules.
hard_gates: Every edit, crop, caption, asset, platform safe zone and seed must be explicit and approved.
soft_gates: Platform adaptations should preserve one approved story while respecting native viewing behaviour.

failure.fallback: Use a previously approved conservative treatment or return the new treatment for exact review.

regression_cases: A caption-only change preserves transcription and candidate artifacts.
A brand-theme change requires a new treatment approval.
